tagline: Recipes, auto meal plans, a smart pantry and grocery lists
description:
TablePlan is a household kitchen app for your home server.

• Save recipes from any link, screenshot or cookbook photo (AI import with your own OpenAI key)
• Auto-generate a week or month of meals from your recipes, with no repeats and favorites first
• Every recipe scales to the number of people you cook for
• Smart pantry: check items off the shopping list and they get real use-by dates (USDA FoodKeeper). Use half the cream and the date resets to after-opening.
• Email, print or export shopping lists, meal plans (.ics calendar) and pantry reports

One app, one container: recipes, plans, lists and pantry are stored in TablePlan itself. Open TablePlan after installing and the setup wizard does the rest.

tips.before_install: After installing, open TablePlan. A short setup wizard creates your login and, if you want, sets up AI import and email.
